answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 22819 Country: United Kingdom Title: I want to know the details of two names; boy name Zain and girl name Reyanna. Are these good names from Islamic perspective. Should we keep these names of our children or change them? Question: I want to know the details of two names; boy name Zain and girl name Reyanna. Are these good names from Islamic perspective. Should we keep these names of our children or change them? Answer ID: 22819 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1060/852/B=1431) If you choose the name Zainul Islam instead of Zain it would be far better; because the name Zain alone means adornment, while Zainul Islam means the adornment of Islam. However, the name Rayyana (ریانہ) for a girl is right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
